  - Kristen/Oliver BAM = 25 contigs = PRIMARY ASSEMBLY ONLY, no decoy/ALT/HLA.
  - Control CRAMs = 3,366 contigs = full analysis set WITH decoy+ALT+HLA (NYGC 1000G standard).
Reads that belong on decoy/ALT/HLA have nowhere to go in K/O's primary-only alignment -> they mismap onto the real chromosomes -> false SNP clusters. And they pass MAPQ>=20 (falsely "unique" with no decoy competitor), so NO post-filter removes them - only re-aligning with decoys does. So K/O's ~10% excess is largely an ALIGNMENT ARTIFACT, not biology. A fair decoy-included re-align would push K/O DOWN toward the controls.

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR THE LETTER: a raw genome-wide variant count is intrinsically pipeline/alignment/ancestry dependent. The 3 controls alone span 67k->84k (+25%) on ONE chromosome purely by ancestry. So "thousands of novel variants" + "obvious shift from GRCh38" are TRUE OF EVERY HUMAN + EVERY PIPELINE - universal, not special. That is itself the refutation.
